network.name: Cardano Preprod
network.note: A Shelley testnet address encoding does not by itself distinguish Preview from Preprod. Preprod is the declared configuration target because --testnet-magic 1 is proposed; no ledger observation is claimed.

binary.extractionMethod: Python tarfile member enumeration and streaming read of the single named regular member; no extractall and no traversal path is used.

nativeSequence.name: address-key-gen
nativeSequence.sourceBasis: Address/Command.hs defines AddressKeyGen; Address/Option.hs parses key-gen from verification/signing outputs; Address/Run.hs generates and writes the Shelley payment pair. Leaf spellings remain a disclosed review point because the imported common-option definitions were not mirrored.

nativeSequence.name: address-key-hash
nativeSequence.sourceBasis: Address/Command.hs defines AddressKeyHash; Address/Option.hs parses a payment verification key or file plus optional output; Address/Run.hs serialises verificationKeyHash as hex.

nativeSequence.name: address-build
nativeSequence.sourceBasis: Address/Command.hs defines AddressBuild with PaymentVerifier, optional StakeIdentifier, NetworkId, and optional output. Address/Run.hs uses PaymentCredentialByKey (verificationKeyHash vkey) and NoStakeAddress when the stake identifier is absent.

nativeSequence.name: address-info
nativeSequence.sourceBasis: Address/Command.hs defines AddressInfo; Address/Info/Run.hs emits type, era, encoding, address, and base16 and classifies a Shelley payment address as payment/shelley/bech32.

sandbox.dynamicRuntimeBinds: Exact AUTH-listed regular non-link files only, read-only, under /lib, /lib64, /usr/lib, or /usr/lib64 destinations; broad /usr, /home, host CLI, and installation fallbacks are forbidden.

validationBeforeWalletCreated: AUTH status, strict field set, strict non-bool integer counters, exact paths, exact modes, scope, archive, source, member, operator hash, linkage, and runtime binds validate.
Archive size and SHA-256 validate before and after native calls.
Archive contains exactly one regular non-link member with the exact name and byte size.
Staged executable SHA-256 equals the measured hash pinned in the actual AUTH before sandbox execution and again after the calls.
ELF class, endianness, x86-64 machine, linkage, and interpreter bind validate against the AUTH.
All native exit codes are zero and no call times out.
The private signing key is present as a regular non-link file and has mode 0600; the operator does not open, read, hash, copy, or print it.
The public verification key parses as a text-envelope JSON object containing even-length hexadecimal cborHex; its exact type string is not invented from the incomplete mirror.
The CLI key-hash output is exactly 56 lowercase hexadecimal characters after stripping.
The built address is a single addr_test1... line.
Address info reports type payment, era shelley, encoding bech32, and the identical address.

The disclosed enterprise check requires base16 to decode to 29 bytes, header byte 0x60, and the final 28 bytes to equal the CLI payment key hash. This is a fail-closed public-format invariant proposed for reviewer agreement, not a signature or ledger proof.
Public files are exported only after all preceding validations pass.

keyRetention.form: CLI-generated PaymentSigningKey text envelope retained only at the private payment.skey path
keyRetention.ownerInstruction: Protect the retained private file offline. Only the public address may be placed in chat or GitHub. This wallet is for test ADA only.

scopedFalseOrExcluded.groth16: Not applicable; no Groth16 proof, circuit, witness, or verifier is in this wallet-creation scope.
scopedFalseOrExcluded.ordinarySelftest: Not applicable; no selftest result is claimed.
scopedFalseOrExcluded.compiledC2Wrapper: Separate and open; this operator is a Python standard-library orchestrator and does not create or validate a C2 wrapper.
scopedFalseOrExcluded.genuineHashOrSignatureQualification: Public file hashes are ordinary integrity pins only. No signature test, qualified cost evidence, settlement evidence, ACTUS evidence, DeFi evidence, general-obligation evidence, private handoff, recursion, bounded multi-parent PCD, universal certificate, or real Preprod transaction evidence is created.

firstBlockedBoundary: Fresh non-author source/effect/security review with two agreeing substantive choices, followed by root completion of the measured staged-binary hash, ordinary data-only ELF linkage/runtime-bind determination, exact operator hash, and a new exact one-run AUTH. No native or key operation is authorized before that boundary.
unknowns: The mirrored files do not include Cardano.CLI.EraBased.Common.Option, the top-level executable dispatch, pNetworkId, pPaymentVerifier, pAddressKeyType, pKeyOutputFormat, or the leaf definitions behind pVerificationKeyFileOut, pSigningKeyFileOut, pMaybeOutputFile, and pAddress.

The exact default address key type and default key output format therefore remain review points; operator.py fails closed if the resulting verification key is not a text-envelope JSON object with cborHex.
ELF linkage, interpreter, and DT_NEEDED runtime files are unknown until ordinary data-only inspection.
The staged member SHA-256 is intentionally not invented and must be measured from the fixed archive before review.
CLI CSPRNG behaviour is delegated to the official binary and /dev/urandom availability inside the sandbox; no entropy is generated by Python.
Address info cannot distinguish Preprod from Preview; Preprod is configuration intent from network magic 1.
No signature test is authorized, so future spendability and live ownership are not proved by address derivation.
